in_scope: React + TypeScript + Vite Brainstorm Web Host
same-origin local backend with durable non-secret Governor session state
fixed official DeepSeek deepseek-v4-pro server-side generation and bounded evaluation
browser interaction, accessibility, responsive, provider, and security acceptance
non_goals: 本轮不修改 P0–P6 Governor runtime、锁定决定或合法状态语义
本轮只接入固定官方 DeepSeek deepseek-v4-pro；不开放任意 Provider URL、不实现真实 multi-provider Council 或生产身份系统
本轮不部署、不配置 DNS、不把真实凭据写入仓库或浏览器、不 push、不 merge 或创建 PR

components.responsibility: Define the frozen frontend domain and API contracts.
Provide the typed host boundary, real HTTP adapter, and explicit test/development mock.
Serve the built UI, own durable non-secret sessions, invoke the existing Governor, and enforce the DeepSeek trust boundary.
Own the versioned allowlisted browser session projection.
Render and coordinate intake, framing, run, capability, human-gate, and handoff flows.
Compose the application shell, navigation, and top-level session lifecycle.

decisions.decision: Use React, TypeScript, Vite, and npm.
decisions.rationale: The repository has no existing frontend stack and the approved host is a browser application.

decisions.decision: Use a same-origin local Python host behind the typed BrainstormApi and keep the mock only in explicit test/development mode.
decisions.rationale: The browser must not receive Provider credentials, and production-path behavior must not silently fall back to a simulation.

decisions.decision: Persist only a versioned, allowlisted, non-secret session projection in sessionStorage.
decisions.rationale: Refresh recovery is required while credentials and other sensitive transient values must never be persisted.

decisions.decision: Use React context and local state without a large state-management dependency.
decisions.rationale: The MVP has one bounded session flow and does not justify another runtime dependency.

decisions.decision: Fix Provider configuration to https://api.deepseek.com and deepseek-v4-pro, resolving DEEPSEEK_API_KEY only on the server.
decisions.rationale: A fixed outbound destination prevents browser-controlled SSRF and credential forwarding while satisfying the approved DeepSeek scope.

controls: provider timeout and response size limits

acceptance.criterion: 标准跳过路径、NEEDS_INPUT 恢复、Council 双 Provider 授权、Provider 失败和刷新恢复均可在浏览器完成；typecheck、lint、行为测试、production build、E2E、无障碍、React 与安全审查全部通过
终端用户无需查看或编辑 Governor JSON 即可完成 Idea Intake 和六 Frame Wizard。
四种 Idea stage 选择分别且仅映射到 Shape、Spark、Stress、Decide。
六 Frame 映射到约定 canonical 字段，并保留 UNKNOWN、ASSUMPTION、KNOWN、CONFLICT 知识分类；AI 建议不得自动成为 KNOWN。
运行页表达完整阶段、Governor 合法状态，并允许 NEEDS_INPUT 在同一 session lineage 中补充信息后恢复。
External Capability Gate 支持 Council Enable/Skip、至少两个独立 Provider 的校验和调用前显式授权。
API key 仅存在于 capability screen 的临时组件状态，不进入持久化、URL、日志、telemetry、manifest、Living Brief、Trace 或真实测试 fixture。
Human Gate 支持 Confirm、Request iteration 和 Provide missing input，且只有 Governor COMMIT 才显示正式 Final Handoff。
标准跳过、NEEDS_INPUT、Council、Provider failure 和刷新恢复场景均通过行为测试与真实浏览器 E2E。
390、768、1280、1440 代表性视口、键盘导航、焦点、标签、错误关联、对比度和 reduced motion 完成验证。
前端 typecheck、lint、单元与集成测试、production build、React review、UI review、安全审查、P7 validator 和 P0–P6 regression 全部通过。
前后端 typecheck、lint、单元与集成测试、production build、真实 Provider smoke、React/UI/安全审查、P7 validator 和 P0–P6 regression 全部通过。
终端用户无需查看或编辑 Governor JSON 即可完成 Idea Intake 和六 Frame Wizard。
四种 Idea stage 选择分别且仅映射到 Shape、Spark、Stress、Decide。
六 Frame 映射到约定 canonical 字段，并保留 UNKNOWN、ASSUMPTION、KNOWN、CONFLICT 知识分类；AI 建议不得自动成为 KNOWN。
运行页表达完整阶段、Governor 合法状态，并允许 NEEDS_INPUT 在同一 session lineage 中补充信息后恢复。
生产路径通过同源服务端 typed BrainstormApi 调用固定官方 DeepSeek deepseek-v4-pro；DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 只从服务端环境变量解析。
浏览器 bundle、sessionStorage、localStorage、URL、日志、telemetry、manifest、Living Brief、Trace、git 和测试 fixture 均不得包含真实 DeepSeek 凭据。
真实 start run 必须产生经 schema 验证的候选、挑战、收敛与 Human Gate review；Provider usage 来自真实响应，缺失时不得估算。
Human Gate Confirm 必须经过独立 bounded evaluator；只有 Governor COMMIT 才显示正式 Final Handoff。
DeepSeek 超时、429、5xx、无效 JSON 或 schema failure 必须返回可恢复且脱敏的错误，不得泄漏响应体、密钥、stack 或内部路径。
development mock 仅限 test/development 显式模式，production path 不得回退或伪装成真实 Governor 结果。
标准路径、NEEDS_INPUT、真实 DeepSeek run、Provider failure、Human Gate、COMMIT handoff 和刷新恢复均通过自动化与真实浏览器 E2E。
390、768、1280、1440 代表性视口、键盘导航、焦点、标签、错误关联、对比度和 reduced motion 完成验证。

gate.summary: T1-T9 are complete. Local checks, the real DeepSeek P1 and independent P6 calls, COMMIT-only handoff, real-result browser recovery, responsive checks, security controls, and durable evidence all pass.
